subject: cult-info-b
title: (R)CULT.INFO.B.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 409 (MID-W-3). CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), with the (DT) prefix, INFO-DS (information dissemination) and PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). INFO-RT (information reality) is on a dotted line from AFL-DY. From INFO-DS: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and MT-INFO (multi-information). From INFO-RT: PART (participation). From MT-INFO: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
